update.how: Opens the download page. Unzip it and run the new Pinku.exe: your shelf and progress come along.

shelf.filter: Look for something on the shelf…
shelf.update_all_tip: Ask MangaDex for new chapters of everything
shelf.add_files_tip: Or drag .cbz files and folders onto the window
shelf.empty_drag: Or drag manga you already have (.cbz files, or folders of them) onto this window.
shelf.empty_where: They're copied into {{.Folder}}, one folder per series.
shelf.drop: Drop to put it on the shelf
shelf.nothing_from_dex: Nothing from MangaDex on the shelf yet.

reader.last: That's the last one on the shelf.
reader.last_dex: That's the last one on the shelf. Check for new chapters to see if there's more.

find.placeholder: Title, or paste a MangaDex link
find.note: Searches {{.MangaDex}}. Pick one and it goes on your shelf, downloaded volume by volume.
find.none: Nothing called that on MangaDex. Try the Japanese title, or fewer words.
find.on_its_way: {{.Title}} is on its way to the shelf.
find.note_more: Searches {{.MangaDex}} and your catalogues. Pick one and it goes on your shelf.

jobs.none: Nothing downloading. Things you add from {{.Find}} show up here.

settings.library_hint: Each series is a folder in here. Put it in OneDrive or on a USB drive if you like.
settings.files_hint: One file per volume makes a tidy shelf. New series use this; ones already on the shelf keep theirs.
settings.not_fetched: Not downloaded yet: it's fetched (about 30 MB, once) the first time you add something.
settings.not_found: Not found: install it with pip install mangadex-downloader.
settings.credits: Downloads by {{.Tool}} from {{.MangaDex}}, where volunteers scanlate. If you love a series, buy the official volumes.

sources.title: Other places to find manga
sources.hint: Add an OPDS catalogue: your own Komga, Kavita or Calibre-web, or a shop that offers one. Its books show up when you search.
